_help: Fix how a letter or word is spoken. Key = the letter/word as in data.js. 'rate' sets the Hear speed and 'slow_rate' the Slow speed (e.g. "-40%"); 'text' replaces what the voice is given to read (the app still shows the original). Find good values with: python tools/generate_audio.py --preview ई. 'voice' gives one item its own voice, e.g. "elevenlabs:<voice_id>" (generated where the ElevenLabs key is available).
